source_evidence: A firm’s relationship summary tells you about: the types of services a firm offers; the fees and costs you will have to pay for those services; conflicts of interest a broker or adviser may have;
question: Misconception: A Form CRS only describes the services a firm offers, not its fees or conflicts of interest.
answer: Correction: A relationship summary covers more than services. It also describes the fees and costs you will pay and conflicts of interest a broker or adviser may have. It can also provide information about standards of conduct, reportable legal or disciplinary history, and questions to ask your financial professional.
